summary: stui writes one line to exits.log beside its panic log each time it ends (when, how long it ran and why: quit, a signal, the terminal closing, an error with its text, or a panic), so a crash that leaves no panic can still be explained

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. stui only.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

recovery.detail: exits.log is in the cache directory beside the run files, bounded to 100 KB, and deleting it loses only history.
